courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 階梯式溢洪道
related.transfer: 可遷移「挑流彈道與落點」與「入水動量與方向」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；階梯式溢洪道的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Jet trajectory and landing point" and "Impact momentum and direction" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Stepped spillways must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦追蹤挑流軌跡入水動量與岩床沖蝕邊界；階梯式溢洪道則以以階梯流態含氣與剩餘能量驗證陡槽性能為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tracing flip-bucket trajectories impact momentum and rock-scour boundaries; Stepped spillways centres on verifying stepped-chute regimes aeration and residual energy, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「挑流彈道與落點」與「臨界水深與單寬流量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到階梯式溢洪道，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「近壁低壓與氣蝕」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Jet trajectory and landing point” and “Critical depth and unit discharge”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Stepped spillways, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Near-wall pressure and cavitation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 滑雪跳台式消能工
history.text: 本課所研究的追蹤挑流軌跡入水動量與岩床沖蝕邊界，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。彈道忽略空氣阻力且以自由射流示意，水墊與岩床反應須另外驗證。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。
history.textEn: The focus on tracing flip-bucket trajectories impact momentum and rock-scour boundaries reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Ballistic examples neglect air resistance and describe free jets; plunge-pool and rock responses require separate verification. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
